messages:
Ravi (PM): Pushed a new prototype for the very-first-run surface. Two ideas: compact checklist modal (dismissible/resumable) + inline helper strip that expands into sample projects. Seeking quick UX + a11y feedback. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/onboard-proto
Nora (Design): Love the compact modal. Inline strip feels lighter but could be easy to miss. Suggest we show the strip only after account creation, modal on fresh sign-up. Also, microcopy: 'Try a sample project' -> too passive. Maybe 'Launch a demo project' or 'Try demo now'.
Chen (Product): Agree on modal for new accounts. We should also include a small status pill in header once they start the checklist: "Onboarding: 2/5" that links back to continue. Data: track which sample is launched and whether they deploy to prod.
Ivy (Frontend): Implementation note: make the strip a <section role=\"region\" aria-label=\"Onboarding quick actions\">, and the modal should trap focus. Quick code for reduced motion:

```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .carousel { transition: none; }
}
```

Also we need focus-visible on card tiles.
Priya (A11y): Contrast issue on the thin outline CTA in the strip. It fails 4.5:1 at 12px. Use stronger fill or darken the border. Keyboard: tiles must be reachable with arrow keys when in carousel mode and have aria-roledescription=\"carousel\" and live region updates when selection changes.
Nora (Design): For desktop, propose a 2x3 grid of sample cards inside the modal instead of a carousel to reduce motion and give immediate choices. Cards should have tiny tags: "Demo", "Low cost", "Prod-ready".
Ravi (PM): Good. We should avoid promising cost numbers; use qualitative tags only. Chen, can backend pass sample.metadata.cost_tier?
Chen (Product): Yes, we can add cost_tier: low/medium/high. We'll expose cost_hint on the API for the UI to render. Also will add telemetry events: onboarding.modal_open, onboarding.sample_launch, onboarding.checklist_resume, onboarding.dismiss_strip.
Ivy (Frontend): UX nit: when user dismisses the strip, show an undo toast with an accessible button and focus management. Don't remove from DOM until focus moved. Example:

```
// on dismiss
undoButton.focus(); // then remove strip
```

Priya (A11y): Exactly — don't shift focus unexpectedly. Also announce with aria-live='polite' "Onboarding saved" when checklist progress persists. For modal: include aria-describedby pointing to the first step summary.
Nora (Design): Microcopy tweaks: steps titled "Create", "Connect", "Verify", "Ship". Modal header: "Set up Redwood in minutes". CTA: primary "Start checklist", secondary "Try a demo".
Ravi (PM): Plan: ship modal + grid for desktop, strip for post-signup mobile. A/B test: variant A = modal-first, variant B = strip-first. Measure completion rate and sample-launch rate.
deploy-bot: Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/onboard/preview?exp=onboard_modal_grid_2026 :white_check_mark:
Chen (Product): One more: add keyboard shortcut `?` to reopen onboarding from anywhere (accessibility & power users). We'll emit onboarding.shortcut_used telemetry.
Ivy (Frontend): I'll add focus tests to Cypress and keyboard traversal cases. Will ensure carousel arrow keys and home/end behavior.
Priya (A11y): PR checklist for me: contrast, focus-visible, aria-live messages, focus trap verification, carousel roledescription. I'll do a full SR walkthrough on mac VoiceOver.
Nora (Design): I'll update Figma with 2x3 grid and alternative mobile stacked cards by EOD. Also will try slightly heavier ctacolors for contrast.
Ravi (PM): Thanks all — schedule a quick 15m playtest on Thu 11am. If staging looks good we'll launch the A/B experiment next week.
Chen (Product): Sounds good. I'll wire the events and sample metadata endpoint this sprint.
Ivy (Frontend): Picking this up after current sprint tasks. Will PR with keyboard tests.
Priya (A11y): Quick reminder: ensure color isn't the only indicator for 'Prod-ready' tag; add an icon or text label.
Ravi (PM): Noted. Closing for now; will post results after the playtest.
